label: AU-privacy-act-1988 Section 20T

obligations.text:
Correction
(2)	If the credit reporting body is satisfied that the personal information is inaccurate, outofdate, incomplete, irrelevant or misleading, the body must take such steps (if any) as are reasonable in the circumstances to correct the information within:

(b)	a credit provider that holds or held the information and that has an Australian link;
the body must consult that interested party, or those interested parties, about the individual’s request.

No charge
(5)	The credit reporting body must not charge the individual for the making of the request or for correcting the information.
